lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I know this is a little sudden,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: but will it rain tomorrow?
What makes you ask?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Belorta wants to go on a long picnic tomorrow,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: but the news said it's gonna rain tomorrow.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Weather forecasts for this area tend to be really accurate.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: If they say it's gonna rain, then it's almost certainly going to.
Right.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Belorta has been asking to hang out for the longest time.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: If it rains, I don't want to go out, so I have to decline her invitation.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Is there no way to make it sunny tomorrow?
You already know the answer to that question.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Oh well...

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I already packed a lunch,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I guess I might as well eat it all.
Would you like to come to the Commander's Room tomorrow?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: How come?
You could enjoy your picnic here.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Can we really do that?
Of course, although it won't be quite the same as having it outside.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I don't know,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I think it'll be really fun.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Will you be there?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'll make another lunch for you.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Oh man, I better tell Belorta too.
Sounds great.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Thanks a bunch, Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: See you tomorrow afternoon.
